rust_summary: loaded chunk handles (`ChunkRef`) and their status.
doc_summary: `host.chunk(level, [x, z])` finds a loaded server chunk. `chunk.pos()`, `level()`, `loaded(host)` and `status(host)` read the handle; after unload or world close, `loaded` returns `false` and `status` returns `None`. Proto chunks are not exposed. Bundles need "hooks": @API:chunk_refs@.
